summary: Iteration 234: Tested burn modal 2-step flow, download page, auth page beta warning, and poll API. Code review confirms BurnModal has correct 2-step implementation with quantity input, quick-select buttons (1, half, All), and large confirmation step. Poll API correctly computes vote counts from local registry. UI testing limited due to wallet session not persisting across page navigations.

ui_bugs.issue: Nested button warning: <button> cannot contain a nested <button>. Copy address button is nested inside creator button.

critical_code_review_comments: BurnModal (lines 319-522): Correctly implements 2-step flow. Step 1 has quantity input (data-testid='burn-quantity-input'), quick-select buttons when myOwned > 1 (data-testid='burn-quick-{q}'), and Next button (data-testid='burn-next-btn'). Step 2 shows large confirmation with quantity (data-testid='burn-confirm-qty'), back button (data-testid='burn-back-btn'), and confirm checkbox (data-testid='burn-confirm-checkbox').
BurnModal console logging: Lines 361, 371, 375 correctly log burn quantity for debugging.
polls.py (lines 201-248): Correctly computes vote counts from local votes mapping when on-chain data unavailable. Handles both list-based and dict-based answer formats.
PollCard.js: 30s auto-refresh interval, post-vote fresh re-fetch with 3s delay.
context_for_next_testing_agent: BurnModal 2-step flow verified via code review. To test UI: login -> navigate to Storefront -> click on object user owns (e.g., 'For real final test' at address msBayXP6iCByaHeMteiwmXMbS74x91MmqY) -> click Burn button. Quick-select buttons only appear when user owns > 1 of the object. Poll API working correctly with vote counts computed from local registry.
